title: scan request
description: The params object of the `scan` tool: every line of the files in scope that holds an exact string or matches a pattern, in root, path and line order. Not ranked and not tokenized, so it finds codes, amounts, punctuation and parts of words that find cannot. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

pattern.description: A literal (mode literal) or a pattern in the subset of docs/decisions/0006-pattern-search.md section 2 (mode regex). 1 to 1,024 bytes of UTF-8 (the engine counts bytes), with no line break: matching is per line.

mode.description: literal: the pattern is the exact string. regex: the subset (classes, \d \w \s \b, anchors, groups, alternation, greedy quantifiers); anything else is refused with its byte offset.

case.description: smart is insensitive unless the pattern holds a code point that case folding changes. Folding is Unicode simple case folding.

whole_word.description: Only matches with no word character just before or after. Word characters are letters, digits and combining marks (Mn, Mc) of any script, and the joiners; _ is not one.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.

name_glob.description: Matched against the file name (the last path component): * is any run of code points, ? one code point, every other code point itself; case-sensitive; no /.

context_lines.description: Lines of context before and after each hit.

max_hits_per_file.description: At most this many hit lines from one file; files_capped counts files that had more.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor. One from another generation (or another walk of the folder) is refused as a stale cursor, one from another request as not belonging to this request.

time_budget_ms.description: How long this page may search, in milliseconds; a page that runs out ends with stopped time and a cursor to continue.
